lines.zh: 我飞起来像盏晃动的灯
lines.en: I fly like a swinging lamp
A pumpkin shell sits on my head
I smell sweet
I fly toward the lights
My wings are orange

lines.zh: 我从枝头滑下，壳先着地。
lines.en: I slide off the branch, shell landing first.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，壳上的火照脚。
lines.en: I circle you, my shell-fire lighting your feet.
The fire inside my shell sways
I fly low, close to the ground

lines.zh: 我的影子是个圆圆的头
lines.en: My shadow is a round head
I beat my orange wings

lines.zh: 我朝幽魂橡木的方向去
lines.en: I head for the ghost oaks
I circle a dead branch
My shell brushes the leaves
I slide along the wind
I pause above the vines
I hang by the pumpkin vines
The light in my shell flickers
When I am still, the light settles
Nothing interesting here

lines.zh: 我的壳很沉，但我习惯了
lines.en: My shell is heavy, but I am used to it
I tilt, and the shell tilts
The sweet smell on me will not fade
There is not enough light in this wood

lines.zh: 天再暗一点，我的壳才亮。
lines.en: When it's darker, my shell will glow.
There is a mouth carved in my shell
The flame jumps inside

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向风，让火别灭。
lines.en: I turn slowly into the wind so the fire won't die.
You are looking at my head
This is not my face, it is a shell
The little fire inside is mine
What are you laughing at
Do I look like a lamp when I fly

lines.zh: 你身上的东西也能亮吗
lines.en: Can the thing you carry light up too
I cannot take this shell off
Stand back, the flame jumps
I am round, but I am not slow

lines.zh: 你的火把晃眼，我的壳不服。
lines.en: Your torch is bright; my shell won't be outshone.
A crack opened in my shell
The flame got blown sideways

lines.zh: 壳裂了，火从缝里往外舔。
lines.en: My shell cracks and fire licks out through the seam.
That landed on my head
Two seeds fell out
I fly up out of reach
The sweet smell scattered
My wing is a little scorched
I land back on the branch
My shell feels heavier now
Sweet things, I am very sensitive to them
This jack-o'-lantern tastes good.

lines.zh: 举那么高，是给我照路吗？
lines.en: Held that high, is it lighting my way?
I eat sweets, and other things too
Set it down, I will fly over
The jack-o'-lantern I throw flies.
I would rather set it alight

lines.zh: 你手一抖，糖就掉地上了。
lines.en: One shake of your hand and the candy drops.
This beats pumpkin
Give it and I will fly a circle for you

lines.zh: 你的额头磕在我的南瓜壳上。
lines.en: Your forehead knocks against my pumpkin shell.
The shell thuds loudly
I tilted and the flame bent
That dented my shell

lines.zh: 我弹开半圈，火苗才稳住。
lines.en: I bounce half a circle before the flame steadies.
My shell butted you once

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，壳响了一声
lines.en: We collided and the shell clacked

lines.zh: 我的甜味都蹭你身上了
lines.en: My sweetness rubbed off on you
I fly around you
We both pulled back

lines.zh: 林子里同类不多，叫声很孤单。
lines.en: Few of my kind in these woods — a lonely call.

lines.zh: 两只南瓜头撞在一起会响
lines.en: Two pumpkin heads knock together loudly
Our flames look at each other
Flying together we look like two lamps
Its shell is a size smaller
We circle the same tree
Its shell has a crack
Later it flew into the mist
Enough pumpkins here for two
Pumpkins will grow again next year
I hug it with my claws
Pumpkins are too heavy, I cannot lift them
This one is sweet
I carry it a short way
I tuck it into my shell
If it falls, I follow it down
I bite off a corner; it's sickly sweet.
Seeds scatter on the ground
I cannot carry this
I hang it in the fork
Something is in the wood
I see your lamp
I fly toward the light
I have stayed on this tree a while
My flame jumped
I have pointed it at you
The light in my shell is growing brighter

lines.zh: 你再走三步，就进火光了。
lines.en: Three more steps and you're in my firelight.

lines.zh: 壳里的火憋足了，我抬爪。
lines.en: The fire in my shell is ready; I raise a claw.
I come down from the tree
I fly above you
My shell faces you
The flame leans forward

lines.zh: 我把壳压低，火光扫你脚。
lines.en: I lower my shell and the firelight sweeps your feet.
If you do not look, I come closer
The mist in the wood is thick
The flame lights my wings
There are too many trees here
I come a little lower
Almost in range
I swoop and ram you
The corner of my shell jabs you

lines.zh: 南瓜灯脱手，冲你脸上炸。
lines.en: The jack-o'-lantern leaves my grip and bursts at your face.
I jerk my head and the shell horn hits you.
The pumpkin shell hits your shoulder
The firelight dazzled you
I fly back onto the branch
That knock was not heavy
My shell cracked a little
I retreat to the tree
I come out of the pumpkin vines
One more lamp on this tree
My shell is still warm

lines.zh: 我飞起来的时候壳晃了晃
lines.en: My shell wobbles as I take off
There is a sweet smell in this wood
I rest on a branch first
The flame catches for the first time
Pumpkins here, good
I do not stand out in the tree shadow
I fly toward the light
Fire makes my shell crackle

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下来，壳摔开了
lines.en: I fall from the tree and the shell splits
Water and my fire do not mix
The blast blew my flame out
Something flying punched through my shell
That force pressed my flame low

lines.zh: 没有甜东西，我越来越蔫
lines.en: No sweets, and I wilt

lines.zh: 雷光落下，我的壳差点灭了。
lines.en: The lightning falls and my shell almost goes out.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有南瓜可以长
lines.en: No pumpkins grow in the void
